candidates.rationale: Alex Rivera has documented TypeScript use in B2B applications but lacks explicit Python API experience.

evidence.quote: Built B2B applications with React and TypeScript.

No mention of Python or API development is present in Alex Rivera's CV.

dataAccess.sql: SELECT candidate_id, display_name, document_name, cv_text FROM talentlens.candidates LIMIT 25

evidenceSources.text: FICTIONAL PROFILE FOR DEMONSTRATION Alex Rivera Frontend Developer Experience: 2021–2026 at Product One. Built B2B applications with React and TypeScript. Led the creation of a design system with 35 components. Added automated tests with Playwright and Vitest. Collaborated weekly with design and product teams. In 2025, improved accessibility with keyboard navigation and WCAG audits. A demonstration portfolio is available during the interview.

FICTIONAL PROFILE FOR DEMONSTRATION Sam Torres Full Stack Developer Experience: 2022–2026 at Services Two. Developed APIs with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL. Built internal dashboards with React and JavaScript. Backend testing with pytest. Collaborated with product teams on delivery planning. Automated deployments with Docker. Interested in learning TypeScript and developing web accessibility skills.

FICTIONAL PROFILE FOR DEMONSTRATION Dani Vega Product Designer Experience: 2020–2026 at Studio Three. Designed B2B products in Figma and conducted user research. Created design systems and documented accessible components. Worked daily with frontend developers. Produced high-fidelity prototypes, usability tests and user flows. Knowledge of HTML and CSS. No professional programming experience declared.
